title: track.add
description: Shows count more track slots after the visible ones (default 1), as the + button of OpenTune's track panel does. If fewer hidden slots remain, the call fails with INVALID_ARGUMENT(track_limit) and shows none. changes lists every track that became visible (member visible), and visibleTrackCount gives the number of visible tracks before and after. A shown track keeps the clips it holds, as a later track can after a project was opened. The number of visible tracks is view state (PROTOCOL.md section 15.2 rule 6) and is not saved with the project (warning NOT_PERSISTED): the undo reason is not_persisted_state, revert is null, and the project is not marked as changed, as with the + button.
